 Most recent Most popular Post published at 18:26 GMT 18:26 GMT 
 HT: Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Who saw that one coming then?
 A really poor half from Manchester City and the errors just seem to be mounting up.
 Losing the ball cheaply in the middle of the pitch, costly individual errors and looking seriously vulnerable at times.
 If things stay the same it would be a third defeat in a row in the league for City, unfamiliar territory for them.
 18 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'First bit of patience from City' published at 18:21 GMT 18:21 GMT 
 HT: Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 That's the first bit of real pressure and patience we've seen from City so far, Forest are getting deeper and deeper which is expected. 
 This is probably what we'll see throughout the second half. 
 114 87 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 18:20 GMT 18:20 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Nottingham Forest with a two-goal advantage at the break. What a 45 minutes for the hosts.
 For Manchester City, a big team talk and a big second half is needed.

 Post published at 18:19 GMT 18:19 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 The corner is delivered deep to the back post and Erling Haaland tries to hook it back into the mix but instead it goes out for a goal kick.
 197 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:17 GMT 18:17 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Manchester City win a free-kick in the final minute of the first half.
 Enzo Fernandez takes it short and it comes to Jeremy Doku on the let, who wins a corner.
 80 176 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:14 GMT 18:14 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Man City just don't have the mentality to compete for the title. Too many players like Anderson, Cherki, Khusanov, Ndiaye, Guehi just happy to make up the numbers. No leaders to step up like Kompany, Aguero, De Bruyne, Rodri etc of the successful City teams in recent history.
 Ted, Manchester 
 806 635 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 18:14 GMT 18:14 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 More direct from Manchester City as Josko Gvardiol nudges across for Erling Haaland and he takes the ball around Matz Sels but the shot from a tight angle is cleared off the line.
 City win a corner and it comes to Elliot Anderson but his effort from range is saved.
 197 81 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:12 GMT 18:12 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Iliman Ndiaye goes down under a challenge from Murillo, it looks like a flailing arm but the referee sees nothing in that.
 Murillo puts the ball out of play in a gesture of sportsmanship with Ndiaye clutching his face but the referee is still having none of it. Neither is VAR.
 Image source, PA Media 
 252 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'City are being bullied' published at 18:10 GMT 18:10 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 We know Man City aren't a soft team. But they're getting bullied in the middle of the park at the minute. 
 Forest are first to everything, they're being really aggressive. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 794 79 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:09 GMT 18:09 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Bit of a goalmouth scramble as the corner comes in and Matz Sels flaps at the ball. He is fortunate it falls behind and not at the feet of a City player as it would have been an easy tap in.
 115 66 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:09 GMT 18:09 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Manchester City win a corner.
 Just less than 10 minutes to go until the break and things would look a lot better for the visitors if they could pull a goal back before then.
 83 246 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:07 GMT 18:07 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Simple fact of the matter is Maresca isn't good enough, and the players don't care any more.
 Chris, Droylsden 
 We have no midfield because Maresca tied his flag to Fernandez. This starting midfield doesn't work.
 Alan, Manchester 
 635 136 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Collective performance after a tough week' published at 18:05 GMT 18:05 GMT 
 FT: Fulham 1-1 Newcastle 
 Newcastle United 
 Newcastle winger Jacob Murphy, speaking to Premier League Studios: "We're unhappy not to come away with three points. But we're delighted with the overall performance.
 "We've had a tough week and we bounced back. That was a collective performance, everyone stood up and were counted for.
 "We've always been a committed group and I think we showed that today. We didn't let Fulham play the style they wanted, we made it uncomfortable for them and, on another day, we're 2-0 up in the first half.
 "Disappointed we conceded after the goal but it's a point in the right direction."
 87 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Midfielders aren't getting back' published at 18:04 GMT 18:04 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 It's been a terrific start, the start Oliver Glasner will have wanted - he'll be disappointed if he doesn't go on to win it.
 The City goalkeeper and defenders are all just pointing at each other. 
 Two midfield players aren't getting back in, Enzo Fernandez and Rayan Cherki aren't getting back. It's becoming increasingly difficult. 
 346 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:04 GMT 18:04 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Manchester City seem to have taken the sting out of the game for now but they are still incredibly vulnerable to the counter attack.
 Erling Haaland gets City's first shot on target but it was an easy save for Matz Sels.
 194 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Donnarumma's jitters published at 18:02 GMT 18:02 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at the City Ground 
 That last Forest attack summed up Gianluigi Donnarumma's recent form and confidence.
 A cross came in which was too long, the City goalkeeper could have caught it and set his side off on a quick counter, but instead withdraws his hands and lets the ball sail out of play.
 The Italy international is not having a good season.
 437 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's about who gets the next goal' published at 18:00 GMT 18:00 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 It's about how Man City react from that and who gets the next goal.
 It makes Forest's life easier but it also makes them nervous when it's only 25 minutes played.
 235 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'This goal shows everyone Rodrigo is here' published at 17:59 GMT 17:59 GMT 
 FT: Fulham 1-1 Newcastle 
 Fulham 
 Fulham striker Rodrigo Muniz, speaking to Premier League Studios: "Last game was really difficult against Aston Villa then this week we trained hard, we knew this would be a tough game.
 "Newcastle have some really good players so happy to score to help my team-mates.
 "I train hard every week to get a chance to play and to score. I need to be ready. In the first half, I said to Kevin 'I need to be ready, I need to warm-up good and when I come on I need to do everything'.
 "Last season was really difficult for me. This goal was really important for me. Last season, I scored only one goal, not good. I want to play more and this goal shows everyone Rodrigo is here."
 75 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:58 GMT 17:58 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 City fans, what is going wrong here?
 Has Enzo Maresca got his team set up wrong? Where are the errors coming from?
 373 70 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'City are feeling massive pressure' published at 17:56 GMT 17:56 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-0 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 These are superstar footballers but if you put a bit of pressure on them, with a bit of work rate, all of a sudden they're feeling a massive pressure. 
 There's always a Forest player in a Man City players face.
